{{Quote|Fuzzy, transmit Packet One to Sith-for-brains back there.|Myri Antilles to Fuzzy|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Fuzzy''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] who served as [[Myri Antilles]]'s [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] during a [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. Wraith Squadron was a recently reformed [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit assigned to apprehend corrupt Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] for his involvement with the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]].<ref name="MK" />
 
Fuzzy was a flaking [[Color/Legends|gray]] droid that Wraith Squadron [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Trey Courser]] had barely managed to restore to working order.<ref name="MK" />
